title: Easy Going Slovakian Lamb Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting Slovakian dish featuring lamb mince, cheese, and a low-fat friendly approach, perfect for a lazy Sunday
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius
In a large pan, cook the lamb mince over medium heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent
In a large bowl, combine the cooked lamb mixture, shredded cheese, eggs, salt, black pepper, and paprika, and mix well
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and place it in a bain-marie
Bake for 40 minutes, or until the casserole is set and the cheese is melted and golden brown
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired
